elements.name: The Images
elements.subtitle: The study the candidate reports. Upload every image in the order they should be read — a plain film and its lateral are a sequence, not a set. These go to the protected store: they are never served from a public folder and every view is a short-lived signed link.

elements.label: Case Images
elements.hint: Stored privately. Removing an image here detaches it from the case; the file stays in the media library

elements.name: The Case
elements.subtitle: What the candidate reads beside the images.

elements.label: Paper
elements.placeholder: Which paper does this case belong to?

elements.label: Case Title
elements.hint: Staff-facing. Candidates see cases numbered in order, not by title

elements.label: Clinical Brief
elements.placeholder: e.g. 54-year-old man, three days of breathlessness and pleuritic pain.
elements.hint: The context the candidate is given before looking at the images

elements.label: Reporting Instruction
elements.hint: Shown directly above the report box

elements.name: Marking
elements.subtitle: The model answer the candidate compares their report against once the paper has ended, and the mark it is worth.

elements.label: Model Answer
elements.hint: Never sent to the candidate while the paper is open — not withheld by the page, but genuinely absent from what the sitting is served. It is read only once they end the paper

elements.label: Maximum Score
elements.hint: The ceiling a self-mark is validated against, and what this case contributes to the paper total. Half marks are allowed

elements.label: Status
elements.hint: Inactive removes it from new sittings only. Anyone part-way through, and every finished sitting, keeps it exactly as served

elements.label: Display Order
elements.hint: The order cases are served in within the paper
